Simulate a Realistic Multi-Facet LLM Coding & Validation Study

Source: R/simulate.R
simulate_coding_study.Rd

Generates a complete synthetic research dataset combining:

  1. Units (optionally nested in clusters) with covariates, subgroup membership, latent true scores, and a human gold-standard validation subset (NA on unlabeled units).

  2. Multi-facet LLM scorings executed via coding_design(), code_texts(), and backend_mock() with configurable reliability variance components, calibration slope/bias, and Differential Prompt Functioning (DPF).

Usage

simulate_coding_study(
  n_units = 120L,
  n_labeled = 40L,
  n_clusters = 30L,
  prompts = c(direct = "Rate construct intensity: {text}", rubric =
    "Apply anchored rubric: {text}", cot = "Reason carefully then rate: {text}"),
  models = c("model_a", "model_b"),
  beta = c(`(Intercept)` = 2.5, x = 1.1, group_b = 0.6),
  cluster_sd = 0.5,
  resid_sd = 0.8,
  llm_intercept = 0.4,
  llm_slope = 0.85,
  llm_error_sd = 0.45,
  prompt_sd = 0.25,
  model_sd = 0.2,
  unit_prompt_sd = 0.25,
  unit_model_sd = 0.2,
  dpf_uniform = c(group_b = 0.55),
  dpf_nonuniform = NULL,
  dpf_prompt_group = NULL,
  seed = 2026L
)

Arguments

n_units

Total number of text units. Default 120L.

n_labeled

Number of units with observed human gold-standard scores. Default 40L.

n_clusters

Number of clusters (e.g., participants or classrooms) that units are nested within. Default 30L.

prompts

Named character vector of prompt templates.

models

Character vector of model names.

beta

Named or unnamed length-3 numeric vector c(intercept, beta_x, beta_group) governing the true data-generating regression \(Y_i = \beta_0 + \beta_x X_i + \beta_g \mathbb{I}(G_i = B) + u_{c(i)} + \varepsilon_i\).

cluster_sd

SD of cluster random intercept \(u_c\). Default 0.5.

resid_sd

SD of unit-level outcome residual \(\varepsilon_i\). Default 0.8.

llm_intercept

Additive LLM calibration bias. Default 0.4.

llm_slope

LLM calibration slope on true score. Default 0.85.

llm_error_sd

Residual LLM measurement noise SD. Default 0.45.

prompt_sd

SD of prompt main effects. Default 0.25.

model_sd

SD of model main effects. Default 0.20.

unit_prompt_sd

SD of unit x prompt interaction. Default 0.25.

unit_model_sd

SD of unit x model interaction. Default 0.20.

dpf_uniform

Optional named vector of uniform subgroup DPF shifts (e.g., c(group_b = 0.6)).

dpf_nonuniform

Optional named vector of non-uniform subgroup DPF slope shifts.

dpf_prompt_group

Optional matrix of prompt-by-group DPF shifts.

seed

Integer random seed. Default 2026L.

Value

A list with:

  • coded: an llm_coded_data object (long multi-facet scores).

  • unit_data: unit-level tibble with aggregated llm_score, human_score (NA on unlabeled units), true_score, x, group, and cluster.

  • true_beta: ground-truth regression parameters.

Examples

sim <- simulate_coding_study(n_units = 40, n_labeled = 20, n_clusters = 10, seed = 1)
g_study(sim$coded)
#> 
#> ── Generalizability Study (G-Study) 
#> Units (unit_id): 40 | Facets: prompt=3, model=2 | Method: REML | Balanced: TRUE
